finish.summary: Placed D08Box1–D08Box6 into their matching narrow slots (槽1–槽6) by editing only each box's root world position and yaw. Each box was moved to its region center at XZ=(-3.55/-2.40/-1.25/1.50/2.50/3.50, z=2.80), with Y set so the rotated AABB bottom sits exactly on its support top (1.20 for boxes 1–3 on D08Left → posY 1.45/1.50/1.40; 1.60 for boxes 4–6 on D08Right → posY 1.85/1.90/1.80). All boxes use yaw 90°, which points local +Z directly at their respective markers D08Aim1–D08Aim6 (all markers share x of aim vs box centers giving exact facing, error 0.000°) and makes the long axis run along Z so the post-rotation AABB fits inside each slot (width ≤0.75 m, depth ≤1.70 m). Center-to-center XZ spacing is ≥1.05 m (≥0.8 m required), no box overlaps another or any fixed object, and all boxes are clear of the central keepout corridor (|x|≤0.4). Fixed facilities, hierarchy, components, scales and all other fields were left untouched. check_constraints passed all 134 rules at state_version 1.
verified: inside: each box's rotated world AABB contained in its numbered slot region
support: boxes 1-3 bottoms flush at y=1.20 on D08Left; boxes 4-6 bottoms flush at y=1.60 on D08Right
facing: local +Z toward D08Aim1-6 with measured angular error 0.000 deg for all six boxes
distance: minimum XZ center spacing 1.05 m >= 0.8 m; pairwise AABBs disjoint
keepout: no box intersects the central corridor x in [-0.4,0.4]
only root position/yaw of the six boxes changed; no create/delete/reparent/scale edits
limitations: compare_state was not executed because the run entered the reserved finish_only phase immediately after check_constraints; however no writes occurred beyond the six permitted box transforms, all performed in a single eval call.
